cards.title: Watchlist level badge: wlBadgeHtml module, wlBadge.css and unit tests
cards.context: WHY: REQ-UI-01. A reusable presentation helper that shows a client's Watchlist level as a badge with the text 'WL 1'..'WL 4', each level in its brand colour. Nothing uses it yet: client list, screens, persistence, level computation, deployment, docs, dark mode, i18n, ARIA are out of scope. Project rules (CLAUDE.md): plain Node 18+ ESM (.mjs), no npm dependencies, node:test + node:assert/strict. Commit format ': ', no AI attribution. FILES (create exactly these three; change nothing else, not web/tokens.css, package.json, docs): web/wlBadge.mjs, web/wlBadge.css, test/web/wlBadge.test.mjs. web/wlBadge.mjs: pure ESM, no imports, no I/O, no default export. Only export: 'export function wlBadgeHtml(level)'. For 1..4 returns exactly 'WL N' (no extra attributes, whitespace or newline). Strict validation (X-input-types): accept only 'typeof level === "number" && Number.isInteger(level) && level >= 1 && level <= 4'. Anything else throws RangeError (never TypeError, never a returned string): 0, 5, -1, -0, 1.5, 3.999, NaN, +-Infinity, '2', 'WL 2', '', 2n, true, null, undefined, no argument, new Number(2), [1], {}, Symbol('x'). Message names the bad value and range 1-4, e.g. 'wlBadgeHtml: level must be 1-4, got 5'; build it with string concatenation and String(level), NOT a template literal (Symbol would throw TypeError). Tests assert only instanceof RangeError. Build output only after validation. No colour word, hex or colour function in this file, even in comments. web/wlBadge.css: no @import of tokens.css (the page loads it first), no custom-property definitions. Rule .wl-badge has exactly five declarations: display: inline-block; font-family: var(--font-sans); color: var(--on-wl); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); padding: var(--space-1) calc(var(--space-1) * 2) (this shorthand). No font-size, font-weight, line-height, margin, width, height (UX-design: inherit size/weight). Exactly four modifiers .wl-badge--1..--4, no other .wl-badge--*; each has exactly one declaration 'background-color: var(--wl-N)'. No colour literal or keyword (no white, transparent, currentColor...). TOKENS (web/tokens.css, read-only): --font-sans, --radius-pill, --space-1, --on-wl, --wl-1..--wl-4. BRAND (.deliver/knowledge/brand-visual.md, read all): BV-colours only var(--...) tokens, no colour value in any other file incl. tests; BV-type var(--font-sans); BV-contrast WCAG 2.2 AA >= 4.5:1; BV-shape var(--radius-pill), var(--space-1); BV-voice short text, no '!'. TESTS test/web/wlBadge.test.mjs (TDD): import only node:* built-ins and '../../web/wlBadge.mjs'; resolve CSS/tokens via import.meta.url. Cover: AC-1 strict equality + repeat calls; AC-2/AC-3 assert.throws RangeError for every input above; AC-9 text 'WL N', 4 chars, no '!'; AC-5/AC-7 parse wlBadge.css statically (strip comments, split rules/declarations) and compare each rule's declarations to an exact allow-list (do not list colour names in the test: that would break BV-colours); only .wl-badge--1..4 selectors; AC-6 no '#hex', no colour function, no custom-property definition in css/mjs, mjs has no import and no fs/fetch; AC-8 read web/tokens.css at runtime, parse hex of --on-wl and --wl-1..4, compute WCAG contrast >= 4.5 (today ~6.29, 5.93, 5.93, 8.16); never hard-code a hex value in the test. AC-10: 'node --test' from the repo root exits 0 and picks the file up. NOTE: QA's integration tests live in test/web/qa/ (qa_scope) and are written by the QA role; the plan's AC-10 'only three files' applies to the dev's diff. PM DECISION: also throw RangeError for Object.create(null) and objects whose toString throws; the message code must not throw (fall back to typeof level when String(level) throws). Spec: .work/*/specs/T-01.md item 16.
acceptance: 1. (AC-1) Given `web/wlBadge.mjs`, when `wlBadgeHtml(N)` is called for N = 1, 2, 3, 4, then it returns exactly `WL N` (`assert.strictEqual`, no newline); a second call with the same N returns an identical string.
2. (AC-1, AC-10) The module's only export is the named function `wlBadgeHtml` (`Object.keys(mod)` deep-equals `['wlBadgeHtml']`, no `default`), and `wlBadgeHtml.length === 1`.

3. (AC-2) Given numbers outside the range or not whole, when `wlBadgeHtml` is called with each of `0, 5, -1, -0, 1.5, 3.999, NaN, Infinity, -Infinity`, then it throws an error with `instanceof RangeError`; never a TypeError, never returns a string.

4. (AC-3, X-input-types) Given non-number or boxed inputs, when called with each of `"2", "WL 2", "", 2n, true, null, undefined`, no argument, `new Number(2)`, `[1]`, `{}`, `Symbol('x')`, then it throws a `RangeError`; `Symbol('x')` must not cause a TypeError.

5. (AC-4, X-error-message) The RangeError message names the bad value and the range 1-4, e.g. `wlBadgeHtml: level must be 1-4, got 5`. Tests assert only `instanceof RangeError`; review checks the wording.

6. (AC-5) Given `web/wlBadge.css` (comments removed), when its rules are parsed, then it has the selectors exactly `.wl-badge`, `.wl-badge--1`, `.wl-badge--2`, `.wl-badge--3`, `.wl-badge--4`; no other `.wl-badge--*`, no other rule, no at-rule (no `@import`).
7. (AC-5) Each `.wl-badge--N` has exactly one declaration: `background-color: var(--wl-N)`, N matching the selector.

8. (AC-7, AC-5, UX-design) `.wl-badge` has exactly these five declarations (allow-list): `display: inline-block`, `font-family: var(--font-sans)`, `color: var(--on-wl)`, `border-radius: var(--radius-pill)`, `padding: var(--space-1) calc(var(--space-1) * 2)`; no `font-size`, `font-weight`, `line-height`, `margin`, `width`, `height`.

9. (AC-6, BV-colours) The raw text of `web/wlBadge.css` and `web/wlBadge.mjs`, comments included, has no hex colour (`#` + 3, 4, 6 or 8 hex digits), no colour function (`rgb(`, `rgba(`, `hsl(`, `hsla(`, `hwb(`, `lab(`, `lch(`, `oklab(`, `oklch(`, `color(`) and no custom-property definition (`--name:`). Colour keywords in the CSS are excluded by the allow-list in items 7-8.

10. (AC-8, BV-contrast, UX-a11y) Given `web/tokens.css` read at runtime, when the WCAG contrast of `--on-wl` against each of `--wl-1..--wl-4` is computed, then it is at least 4.5 (today 6.29, 5.93, 5.93, 8.16). The test hard-codes no hex value.
11. (AC-9, BV-voice) For N = 1..4 the text between `>` and `` equals `WL N`, has length 4 and no `!`.
12. (AC-10, ARC-deps) `web/wlBadge.mjs` has no `import` (static or dynamic) and no `require`, `fetch`, `process`, `node:fs` or `readFile`.
13. (AC-10, ARC-deps) `test/web/wlBadge.test.mjs` imports only `node:*` built-ins and `../../web/wlBadge.mjs`; CSS and token files are located through `import.meta.url`.
14. (AC-10, DEL-ci, TST-strategy) `node --test` and `node --test test/web/wlBadge.test.mjs` from the repo root both exit 0, and the first runs the tests in `test/web/wlBadge.test.mjs`.

15. (AC-10) The dev's diff against main is exactly `web/wlBadge.mjs`, `web/wlBadge.css`, `test/web/wlBadge.test.mjs`; `web/tokens.css`, `package.json`, docs unchanged (QA's `test/web/qa/**` does not count).

16. (AC-3, PM decision) `Object.create(null)` and an object whose `toString` throws also throw a `RangeError`, never a TypeError: the message code must not throw (e.g. fall back to `typeof level` when `String(level)` throws).
